message: Operator decision requested for Scheduler Phase 2; no live action has been performed. Do you authorize a dedicated, narrowly scoped non-agent Scheduler service identity to (1) requeue only Challenge-blocked attempts whose required conditions are all Satisfied and whose exact attempt generation and owner state still match; and (2) create durable launch intents and launch only existing Ready worker/reviewer assignments through the existing BrowserBridge, with account/project capacity checks, stable provenance, source-lease/review enforcement, and no replay of uncertain submissions? The Scheduler must not impersonate Manager or the blocked owner, bypass unresolved conditions, or obtain broader authority. This is a new authority boundary. Reply APPROVE or DECLINE and any constraints. This request does not authorize live prompt sends, schedule changes, deployment, restart, migration, or runtime activation; those remain separately gated. Until approval, the planner remains read-only/default-off and the existing Manager remains the only session launcher.
